build_d2go_model_with_hooks: build a D2Go model with modeling hooks applied via a CfgNode configuration
test_modeling_hook_apply_unapply: test applying and unapplying a modeling hook to wrap and unwrap a PyTorch model
create_modeling_hook_plus_one: create a modeling hook that wraps a model to add one to its forward output
create_modeling_hook_times_two: create a modeling hook that wraps a model to multiply its forward output by two
test_modeling_hook_deepcopy: test that a model with applied modeling hooks can be deep copied and unapplied
